evidence: Alters CScriptWitness data representation in src/script/script.{h,cpp} and parsing during evaluation in src/script/interpreter.cpp
rationale: Encapsulating CScriptWitness into a serialized representation eliminates an adversarial memory-exhaustion vector in transaction handling. Worst-case memory allocation for transactions drops from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU, increasing mempool capacity by 13-15% without slowing down validation.
